reviews.text: Autumn is the best! She always gets the vision and my blonde color and cut comes out looking amazing every time. I get so many compliments and the color looks good all the way until my next appointment! Can’t recommend her enough!

Sydney is the best! She is so gentle and patient with hair- even my waist length hair that really likes to tangle. You can tell she cares about what she does and how it makes her clients feel. Such a sweet and talented stylist!

Had recently moved to the area and was hesitant about finding a new hair stylist. Booked with Autumn and she put all my fears to rest! She did a full color and layered cut and I couldn’t be happier. Was such a fun and relaxing experience. Would highly recommend Autumn as a stylist!
